left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria: includes presence of all the following:
  -  one or more clinical symptoms (persistent cough, recurrent hemoptysis, [OR]  weight loss, [OR]  malaise, [OR]  fever  [OR] and dyspnea) for ≥3 months
  -  slowly progressive  [OR] or persistent radiological findings (one or more cavities  [OR] and surrounding fibrosis, [OR]  infiltrates, [OR]  consolidation, with or without fungal ball  [OR] or progressive pleural thickening) on computed tomography (CT) of the thorax
  -  immunological (A

right.raw_text: fumigatus-specific IgG  [OR] >27 mgA/L or positive Aspergillus precipitins) or microbiological evidence of Aspergillus infection  [AND] (growth of Aspergillus in respiratory secretions  [OR] or serum galactomannan index  [OR] >0

left.raw_text:
5 or BALF galactomannan index >1) and,
  -  exclusion of other pulmonary disorders with similar presentation

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  failure to provide informed consent
  -  patients on immunosuppressive drugs, intake of prednisolone  [OR] (or equivalent) >10 mg for at least 3 weeks or a diagnosis of human immunodeficiency virus syndrome
  -  intake antifungal azoles for >3 weeks in the preceding six months
  -  subjects with active pulmonary infection due to mycobacterium tuberculosis  [OR] or mycobacteria other than tuberculosis (MOTT)
  -  subjects with others forms of pulmonary aspergillosis (allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, chronic necrotizing aspergillosis  [OR] and angio-invasive aspergillosis)
  -  pregnancy
